text_block_list.text:
With the Make Debut approaching, Orfevre 
was gradually ramping up the intensity of 
her training.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Insufficient. Add more to the training 
menu."
choice_data_list:
Still, that puts way too much strain on 
you—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The King has declared it so. The rest is 
up to you to figure out.

...In other words, we must thoroughly 
devise a method that minimizes the risk of 
injury while increasing the workload. 
Nothing comes to mind immediately, but—

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfevre! Your drinks are ready right 
here."

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text: Allow me to wipe away your sweat.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Good work.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
âLook, the "daimyo procession" has 
started! Got quite the entourage following 
her today, too~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Is he a daimyo? A king? Well, either 
way, that's pretty amazing..."

There was always someone around 
Orfevre—Umamusume calling themselves her 
"vassals" attending to her.

"Among them are senior Umamusume with far 
more experience than Orfevre, proving her 
appeal spans across all kinds of crowds. 
Suddenly, I wonder—"
choice_data_list:
(I wonder how everyone ended up becoming 
her subjects.)

text_block_list.text:
After training, when I casually asked the 
retainers who were helping clean up 
together—

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious?! It was love at first 
sight, love at first sight!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
"That was the day of my Tracen Academy 
tour... My heart was pounding as I headed 
there, and then—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You there.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Grab your bag. —Follow me.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
With just those few words, my heart was 
completely captivated... and I resolved to 
follow her for the rest of my life.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
It feels quite presumptuous to say now, 
but... back then, I harbored a great deal 
of animosity toward Lady Orfevre...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hey.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I bestow a reward upon you. Rejoice.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
...Wh... What? Where did this come from 
all of a sudden...!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I have paved my path.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
...? ...Ah, you mean tidying up the 
chairs? I just couldn't stand the clutter, 
it wasn't for your sake or anyth—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What an attentive girl. I shall gladly 
accept it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Continue to strive diligently from here 
on. —For your King.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!! ...Y-Yeth...!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
Since then, I've turned over a completely 
new leaf, and now I'm devoted solely to 
Lady Orfevre! I'm doing my best with her 
praise from back then in my heart!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
"If you don't give up and devote yourself, 
I'm sure you will be bestowed a reward 
someday too."

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Let me invite you to the 
Retainers' group LANE too, Trainer!

...I understand that Orfevre is deeply 
admired, but based on what's been said so 
far, it feels like a weak reason to be so 
devotedly dedicated to her.
choice_data_list:
(The fundamental reason I revere her as 
the "King" is—)

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you too! Why did you become a 
retainer? You've been one the longest 
among everyone here, right?

The Umamusume who was called upon seemed 
to be in Orfevre's good graces, always 
attending by her side.

text_block_list.name: One of Orfevre's Retainers
text_block_list.text:
"...I... I was drawn to that person's... 
dazzling strength."

text_block_list.name: One of Orfevre's Retainers
text_block_list.text:
It might be presumptuous for a maiden race 
loser like me to say this. Still, I want 
you to reach ever higher. ...Without 
looking back... as far as you can go—

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It was so obvious that I neglected 
to mention it.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
Though how we became her subjects may 
differ— all of us are helplessly drawn to 
the way she runs.

One day, amid those bustling days. On a 
somewhat melancholic afternoon under 
heavy, overcast clouds...

text_block_list.name: One of Orfevre's Retainers
text_block_list.text:
—My King. Today... I humbly ask for your 
permission to take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You say you are leaving? —This academy, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: One of Orfevre's Retainers
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I am deeply sorry. I wasn't strong 
enough, and I feel utterly ashamed.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I grant you your leave.

With merely two words, Orfevre fell 
silent. "Why," "Where"... She asked 
nothing. After a brief silence lingered...

text_block_list.name: One of Orfevre's Retainers
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you so much for everything. 
...Well then, I shall take my leave—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —My majesty shall...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I shall illuminate the entire universe.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Above your head as well...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It will surely pour down upon us.

"‘No matter where you are, the light will 
reach you’— The look on her loyal 
subject's face made it abundantly clear 
that no such footnotes were needed."

text_block_list.name: One of Orfevre's Retainers
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, yes... yes. I'll be waiting for 
you...!

text_block_list.name: One of Orfevre's Retainers
text_block_list.text:
Until the day I can bask in the King's 
majesty once more...! So as not to bring 
shame upon a loyal subject...! I shall 
give it my all... even in these new 
lands...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Very well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Rejoice. Consider this a parting gift—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

When I hurriedly recorded the times, they 
surpassed yesterday's data. She hadn't 
been slacking off during the measurements. 
Which means...
choice_data_list:
(I've finally surpassed it—to show the 
power of the King)

text_block_list.text:
To show the departing vassal just how 
great the king they served was... and to 
prove that what they believed in was true.

Did her blistering speed tear right 
through the clouds...? Beneath a sky that 
had cleared up before I even realized—

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainers
text_block_list.text: "Lady Orfe...! My King...!"

"Before I knew it, the other subjects had 
gathered as well. Roused by Orfevre, they 
all gazed upon their king with fiery 
eyes—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Engrave it deeply. Yearn for it fiercely.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Reigning for all eternity— The running of 
a King.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainers
text_block_list.text: Gasp!!

text_block_list.name: One of Orfevre's Retainers
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much...!!

"The sight of all her subjects dropping to 
their knees at once was magnificent— I 
felt as if I had witnessed the immense 
caliber of Orfevre's royalty."
